name: NSynth: Neural Audio Synthesis Dataset
description: NSynth (Neural Audio Synthesis) is an audio dataset of musical notes developed by Google Magenta. It contains 305,979 four-second musical notes sampled at 16 kHz across 1,006 individual acoustic, electronic, and synthetic musical instruments. Each note is annotated with pitch, velocity, instrument family, source type, and acoustic qualities (brightness, distortion, multiphonics), providing a standard benchmark for neural audio synthesis and pitch/timbre modeling.
